feedback_intro: Is there a red panda or a zoo the directory doesn't have yet? Tell us here. Please include the name (panda or zoo) and a Red Panda Finder or official zoo-site link. Every report is verified by the author before anything is added. Thanks!

feedback_hub_intro: Thanks for helping make the directory more complete and more useful. Start from the form's "type" dropdown below: report a missing panda or zoo, share other suggestions and feedback, or drop a request in the wishlist. Every report is reviewed by the author before anything is acted on.

thanks_intro: This directory keeps growing thanks to the many fans who help report missing pandas, zoos, and updates. Here are the friends who've helped — thank you! (Listed with their consent to be credited publicly.)

stats_intro: These statistics are computed from the recorded entries at build time and only cover individuals with known dates.
stats_note: Statistics only include individuals with known dates; ages are estimated from birthdays, individuals with unconfirmed sex are excluded from the age distribution, and unverified individuals are excluded entirely. Birthplace is determined by the first residence record.
stats_desc_note: Counts recorded descendants within 2 generations (children, grandchildren).
sources_note: Only official / primary sources (zoo websites, government notices, zoo reports, official social media) are listed. Click to open the original page.
extra_sources_note: Fan blogs, videos and other unofficial records, provided for reference only. Not verified by the zoo.
ft_intro: Every red panda in Japan is really one big family — all {n} of them across {g} generations. Drag to pan, zoom to read, tap any panda to trace its bloodline, or use the dropdown to highlight a zoo’s members.
ft_hint: Drag to pan · scroll / pinch to zoom · tap for bloodline
ft_focus_tip: Tap any panda to see just its bloodline on its own — usually a couple dozen, easy to read.
ft_rel_pick: {name} selected — tap another panda to see how they're related
ft_rel_none: No known blood relation (within our records)
